about: Stony Plain is a town in Alberta’s Capital Region, west of Edmonton toward Spruce Grove on Highway 16A. A historic main street, murals, and suburban growth define a Tri-Municipal neighbour to Spruce Grove and Parkland County. About 18,000 people live in Stony Plain.
seoSummary: Capital Region town west of Edmonton—historic main street and murals beside Spruce Grove on Highway 16A.
